definitions.explanation: A present bought while traveling to give to friends, family, or colleagues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{土産|みやげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

examples.english: What would be good as a souvenir?

examples.japanese: ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{土産|みやげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: To choose souvenirs for the workplace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}ったら→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{土産|みやげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧だ。
examples.english: When you go on a trip, it's normal to buy souvenirs for your coworkers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{土産|みやげ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}えば→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: There were so many types of Hokkaido souvenirs that I couldn't decide what to buy.

notes:
お{土産|みやげ} refers to gifts brought back from trips.

Cultural note: In Japan, it's customary to bring お{土産|みやげ} for coworkers, friends, and family after traveling. This is an important social obligation.

Types:
- Often local specialties ({特産品|とくさんひん}) of the destination
- Food items are very common (sweets, snacks)
- Usually individually packaged for easy distribution at work

Related:
- {名物|めいぶつ}: local specialty/famous product
- お{土産|みやげ}{屋|や}: souvenir shop
- お{土産|みやげ}{話|ばなし}: stories from one's travels
